row: Erica H. O'Meara - Mobile Massage Mentor

Welcome!

Whether you’re a massage therapist looking to elevate your practice or someone who simply wants to better understand your own body, you’re in the right place.

I’m Erica O’Meara - a licensed massage therapist, educator, and owner of Philly Home Massage Collective. After years of working with clients from every walk of life, I’ve learned that great bodywork isn’t just about muscles. It’s about awareness, communication, recovery, and understanding how our daily choices shape the way we feel.

On this channel you’ll find content for both massage therapists and clients.

No matter which side of the table you’re on, my goal is the same: To help people understand the body a little better than they did yesterday.

If that sounds like something you want more of, subscribe and join me!
